name: Shop Coupons
author: Alex - opengamescommunity.com
description: Redeemable codes that credit shop points. Adds a public redeem page, an admin module to create and track codes, and its own table. Written as the reference example of a ZnoteX plugin.
update: Added a redemption log to the admin module: who redeemed which code and when.
Coupon create and delete now show in Admin Panel > Logs.

name: Referral System
author: Alex - opengamescommunity.com
description: Account referral codes with registration tracking, automatic points and premium rewards, My Account injection and an admin overview.
update: My Account injection now works with themes that nest the account heading (e.g. Eclipse).
Admin settings for referrer/new account points and premium days.
Referral ledger with basic same-IP abuse protection.

name: Account Security
author: Alex - opengamescommunity.com
description: Account security adds a box on My Account page with the current IP adress, recent activity, 2FA Status.

name: Daily Rewards
author: Alex - opengamescommunity.com
description: Daily Reward reseted each monday, claim rewards (premium points, premium days, item id / count )

name: Loyalty Shop
author: Alex - opengamescommunity.com
description: Loyalty Shop, Progress bar advancing by tiers giving discounts on shop & purchases.

name: Guild Recruitment
author: Alex - opengamescommunity.com
description: Guild Recruitment enables a box above guilds with posts for guild leaders a recruitment message with an apply button.

name: Battlepass
author: Alex - opengamescommunity.com
description: Battlepass plugin, make missions each day and claim rewards.

name: Purchase History
author: Alex - opengamescommunity.com
description: Purchase History added on a new box inside My Account after character section.

name: Starter Pack
author: Alex - opengamescommunity.com
description: Starter Packs are packs available to purchase directly from buy points website, they appear above.
update: Update Image Path selection, requires last update ZnoteX.

name: Boosted Creatures
author: Alex - opengamescommunity.com
description: Show Boosted Creatures at right/left floating box on website.

name: Wheel of Fortune
author: Alex - opengamescommunity.com

name: Bounty Board
author: Alex - opengamescommunity.com

name: Custom Leaderboards
author: Alex - opengamescommunity.com

name: Forum Avatars
author: Alex - opengamescommunity.com

author: Alex - opengamescommunity.com

author: Alex - opengamescommunity.com

author: Alex - opengamescommunity.com

name: Streamers

name: Server Statistics
author: Alex - opengamescommunity.com
description: Show Server Statistics under community menu.
